symptom: Embedded Codex auto-approved shell, file patches, and session-wide network, inherited the full Electron secret environment, and could spend on Dreamina/Kie/Seedance even though the fork contract is AutoDL H3 + Codex imagegen. Identity lock was advisory, so unfrozen faces still generated.
direct_cause: handleServerRequest accepted every Codex approval method; spawn spread process.env; generateOnProject only appended unfrozen advisories after spend; freezeNodes always stamped by:'user'; seeds and pickers still exposed upstream video/image models.
class_root: Director privileges and paid generate backends were not constrained at the host approval boundary and the generate dispatch boundary; identity freeze was a result annotation instead of a pre-spend gate.
affected_population: Anyone using the embedded Codex director
Canvas users generating video or stills on this fork
entry_points: Codex item/commandExecution/requestApproval, execCommandApproval, item/fileChange/requestApproval, applyPatchApproval, item/permissions/requestApproval
internal_only_reason: Approvals, env inheritance, freeze stamps, and generate vendor policy are Nomi host/catalog invariants. No vendor API is changed.
invariants: Only isCodexNomiToolApproval auto-accepts; shell, file, patch, and network approvals decline.
Codex app-server env is an allowlist plus extraEnv (projects/settings roots), not the Electron process environment.
Paid video generate from MCP dispatch must be autodl-art / autodl-art-h3; paid image generate from MCP must be codex-local / codex-imagegen.
Shot stills/videos that reference unfrozen character/scene/prop cards fail before spend; generating the look card itself is allowed.
MCP freezeNodes records by:'mcp'; other freeze callers record by:'user'.

recurrence.reason: Every director turn hits the same approval handler and spawn env; every MCP/canvas paid generate hits dispatcher or runCatalogGenerationTask; every freeze hits freezeNodes.
same_class_scan: Searched handleServerRequest approval methods, spawn env, process.env spread, freezeNodes by:'user', unfrozenAnchorsForShot advisories, and seedBuiltins vendor list.
generateOnProject is also used by unit tests of generic two-hop with apimart; the product lock is enforced at dispatcher + canvas catalog task, not inside the generic engine.
Builtin seeds remain in catalog for mergeability; generate-time refusal is the spend gate.

prevention.strategy: Fail-closed Codex approvals and allowlisted env; fork generate contract at MCP dispatch and canvas task start; unfrozen refs throw before spend; freeze attribution records the caller.

migration: No persisted schema bump. Existing unfrozen cards must be frozen before the next referenced still/video. Existing catalog rows for other vendors remain on disk but paid generate from director/canvas refuses them. Old freeze records with by:'user' stay as-is.
residual_risks: Direct generateOnProject / runTask / canvas catalog-task callers used by tests and the generic runner can still name other vendors; MCP nomi_generate is product-locked.
Text/audio intents are not locked; assistant text may still use catalog text models.
Codex may require an inherited env var not on the allowlist for a future ChatGPT.app login path; that would surface as a login failure rather than a secret leak.
